title: The Pale Colony
author: Quentin Thornbury
blurb: Rafael Lockridge, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
